tvShow.name: Heart Beat
tvShow.overview: RK Multispeciality Hospital is a beacon of hope and healing. Its doctors are resilient even when they have to deal with medical and personal challenges.

episodes.name: First Day, First Impressions
episodes.overview: Five new doctors join RK Hospitals. On the very first day, things go from bad to worse for Reena, making a poor impression on chief doctor Radhi.

episodes.name: Doctor Drama
episodes.overview: Reena and Rocky are tasked to work with Dr Ramanadhan, aka Cinema Doctor. The doctors are in a tizzy when a child ends up with breathing issues that they can't diagnose.

episodes.name: Tug Of War
episodes.overview: When a surgery becomes problematic, Dr. Ravi freezes during the procedure. Sid leaves a drawing for Radhi inside her laptop, but the busy doctor fails to notice it until Reena helps.

episodes.name: Notes To Night
episodes.overview: It's not all work for our doctors as senior doctors Ravi and Anitha throw a celebratory party. Amidst drinks and merriment, Arjun and Reena reconnect.

episodes.name: Heartbeats and Hangovers
episodes.overview: The doctors experience the aftereffects of the party. A bad fall lands RK in the hospital. He meets the new doctors and learns about Arjun's 'love' interest.

episodes.name: Doubt and Denial in the Shadows
episodes.overview: Radhi gets furious when Reena voices her doubts about RK's medical condition. A concerned RK confides in Radhi. Dejected, Reena chastises Arjun.

episodes.name: Repaired Connections
episodes.overview: Reena feels disheartened as her colleagues shun her. Rocky apologises to her for RK's case. As she reconciles with Arjun, in the hospital, RK receives alarming news from Radhi.

episodes.name: Mistake
episodes.overview: Radhi gets furious with Reena for treating her son during a medical emergency. Realising her mistake, she tries to make amends with Reena. But a shocking news leaves her shattered.

episodes.name: Facing Reality
episodes.overview: Reena likes a flat and decides to move in immediately. Arjun learns about his father's condition. Reena sticks to her ground, unnerving Radhi.

episodes.name: Home Transition
episodes.overview: Ravi feels troubled during a surgery. Reena shifts to her new house. But what happens when she learns about another doctor in the neighbourhood?

episodes.name: Unforgiving Heart
episodes.overview: The past refuses to let Arjun forgive RK despite his health condition. Radhi tries to meet Reena but in vain. Rocky 'falls' for Reena, but is she interested?

episodes.name: Emotional Roller-coaster
episodes.overview: A criminal who is recuperating tries to escape from the hospital. As the situation gets tense, Reena steps in to handle the offender.

episodes.name: Fulfilling Wishes, Finding Love
episodes.overview: Reena breaks down after an exhaustive day at work. Ravi fulfils Jagan's last wish. An impressed Anitha kisses Ravi, leaving him confused.

episodes.name: Doubts in Diagnosis
episodes.overview: Ravi's confrontation leaves Anitha upset. Teju wins an opportunity to assist Radhi in a complicated surgery. However, was Radhi right in her diagnosis?

episodes.name: Unmasking the Threat
episodes.overview: Reena's first surgery is a success. She reprimands Arjun after discovering the truth about him. Radhi learns about the unknown enemy, a threat to her hospital.

episodes.name: House Party
episodes.overview: The doctors gather at Reena's house for a party. Some uninvited guests join in to multiply the fun. Rocky tries to woo Reena. But is she interested?

episodes.name: Healthcare Urgency
episodes.overview: Radhi decides to investigate more about MNM Hospital. Arjun tries to help during an emergency case at the hospital.

episodes.name: Looming Danger
episodes.overview: Teju learns about the looming threat to the hospital. Reena has to reflect on her abandoned childhood to help a teenager take the right step.

episodes.name: Stealth Mission
episodes.overview: Radhi has to relive her past trauma as she convinces Vinusha's father to forgive his daughter. The interns help Arjun to do the unthinkable.

episodes.name: Battlefront Courage
episodes.overview: The unknown enemy has shown his face. But can he win against the spirit of the doctors at RK Hospital?

episodes.name: New Alliance
episodes.overview: Madan has a new ally while Arjun starts getting involved in hospital management. Arjun has a squabble with Reena over their relationship.

episodes.name: Alzheimer's Mystery
episodes.overview: Teju begins her game as she gives a piece of advice to Arjun. Reena drops an Alzheimer’s patient home and is surprised to learn his identity.

episodes.name: Hopeful Hearts
episodes.overview: Anitha is shocked when Ravi reveals a secret. When Arjun seeks RK's permission to get involved in the hospital's activities, he feels hopeful about their relationship.

episodes.name: Heartbreaks and Favours
episodes.overview: Anitha has a heartbreak. RK seeks a favour from Radhi. Both Radhi and Arjun aim to protect the hospital but are they on the same team?

episodes.name: CEO's Rise
episodes.overview: Amidst internal doubts and external threats, RK Hospital faces a pivotal decision. Will Radhi thwart Arjun's rise to CEO, or will RK's plan secure the hospital's future?

episodes.name: Paths to Leadership
episodes.overview: Dev gets caught between defending his children and facing a harsh reality. Amidst personal and professional challenges, Radhi attempts to mentor Arjun as RK Hospital's potential CEO.

episodes.name: Preparing for Destiny
episodes.overview: As Radhi prepares Arjun for a pivotal task, personal and professional worlds collide as secrets unravel at the hospital, friendships are tested, and unexpected connections emerge.

episodes.name: Comedy and Chaos
episodes.overview: A furious Anitha seeks revenge. As Radhi juggles Teju's interference, Arjun's revelation leads to a game-changing conference at RK Hospital. Meanwhile, love is in the air.

episodes.name: Rekindled Connections
episodes.overview: Arjun rekindles the relationship with his father as they go on a fun outing. Reena's childhood friend pays a surprise visit to the hospital.

episodes.name: Unexpected Insights
episodes.overview: Radhi feels defeated as Arjun's pitch gets approved by the board. Dev helps a frustrated Radhi comprehend the situation. Rocky becomes a guest in his dinner plan with Reena.

episodes.name: Complimented Impact
episodes.overview: Radhi acknowledges Arjun's work. Anitha sets clear boundaries for Ravi. As RK opens his heart out to Reena, his compliment shocks her.

episodes.name: Breaking Barriers
episodes.overview: Reena confronts RK about his compliment. Arjun gets closure as he gathers the courage to talk to RK about Pallavi. The well-guarded secret of Radhi and Reena starts to crack.

episodes.name: Protecting the Past
episodes.overview: Sarada, the landlady, gets restless and tries to learn about Reena's past. Naveen makes a blunder that would put his career at risk, but Teju takes a drastic step to protect him.

episodes.name: Heartbeat Moments
episodes.overview: Ravi asks Guna and Rocky for a favour. Sarada invites Dev's family for dinner. While Rocky struggles to convince a patient's family for surgery, things get tense between Guna and Naveen.

episodes.name: Hope In Recovery
episodes.overview: Rocky manages to convince the tribals for surgery, but they have a condition. RK uses his experience to save Naveen's patient. Will Naveen get a second chance?

episodes.name: The Perfect Plan
episodes.overview: Sarada executes her plan to perfection, making both Radhi and Reena restless. A confused Reena tries to get out of the complex situation.

episodes.name: Midnight Mischief
episodes.overview: Radhi and Reena feel overwhelmed when the latter joins Radhi and her family for dinner. Sid and Divi make Reena part of their midnight mischief.

episodes.name: Heart-to-Heart Conversations
episodes.overview: Arjun proposes a celebration for the hospital's 20th anniversary. Anitha decides to talk to Ravi after her chat with Bharathi. Reena gets cornered by the interns about her night out.

episodes.name: Ethnic Elegance
episodes.overview: The hospital wears a festive look on the day of its anniversary. The doctors turn up in ethnic wear. However, the happiness is short-lived as tragedy strikes RK Hospital.

episodes.name: Memories of a Mentor
episodes.overview: The hospital mourns the demise of RK. Everybody reminisces their pleasant memories with him. Anitha feels flustered when Ravi opens up about his marriage.

episodes.name: Clear Waters, Clear Words
episodes.overview: Radhi takes care of Reena when she falls ill. Reena learns about Sarada's lie and confronts her. As Ravi and Anitha are back to being best friends, Bharathi encounters Anitha.

episodes.name: Emotional Tokens
episodes.overview: Anitha is irked as Ravi steals her thunder. Radhi orders Naveen to assist Aruna who obliges. As Reena bids goodbye to Radhi's family, Sid's gift makes them emotional.

episodes.name: Journey of Healing
episodes.overview: Reena compels Arjun to go out with her to help get him out of mourning. Anitha's frustration grows as Ravi gets credit for her hard work.

episodes.name: The Art of Persuasion
episodes.overview: Arjun comes back to the hospital and announces his arrival with a speech. The power dynamic gets interesting as Radhi approves Ramanathan's request despite Arjun rejecting it.

episodes.name: Power Play
episodes.overview: Sid and Divi ask Reena for a favour. Laya bids goodbye to Rocky. When Arjun confronts Radhi for overruling him, she firmly states that he is not the CEO of the hospital.

episodes.name: Unexpected Revelations
episodes.overview: The team is shocked to learn about Guna's father. Arjun gets irked when Reena tries to defend Radhi. Ravi confronts Anitha and she informs him about Bharathi's feelings.

episodes.name: Clash of Egos
episodes.overview: Ravi scolds Bharathi, but Anitha decides to move on. Arjun tries to prove a point, and Radhi puts him down with facts. Things turn ugly between Ravi and Anitha.

episodes.name: Corporate Twist
episodes.overview: Reena helps Sid get into the football team. The race for the post of the CEO takes an interesting turn when Madan makes a grand entry into the hospital.

episodes.name: Team Dynamics
episodes.overview: Radhi announces that two interns will become resident doctors by the end of the year and explains how they will be evaluated. She makes it clear to Madan that she is not his ally.

episodes.name: Mentor Rivalry
episodes.overview: Ravi and Anitha get competitive as they mentor the interns. Guna is unhappy when a celebrity dancer is admitted to the hospital. Dev grows curious as the kids lie about Reena.

episodes.name: Privacy Breach
episodes.overview: Teju reckons that Reena and Guna's diagnosis might be wrong. Jennifer tries to spend time with Guna. Bharathi confronts Anitha for revealing her secret to Ravi.

episodes.name: Rivalry Victorious
episodes.overview: Dev confronts Reena about her visit to the kid's school. As Teju cracks the case and takes it over from Reena and Guna, Ravi feels victorious.

episodes.name: Strife and Solidarity
episodes.overview: Reena argues with Radhi regarding a case. Charu seeks Rocky's help to plan a party. While Madan fails to manipulate Arjun, the group reunites as Guna and Naveen bury the hatchet.

episodes.name: Emotional Breakdown
episodes.overview: Dev runs into Ganesh and realises that Reena lied to him. In the hospital, Reena breaks down as she fails to save the baby. Radhi consoles her and gives her some advice.

episodes.name: Social Tensions
episodes.overview: The interns manage to get Radhi's permission to attend the party. Ravi rants to Arjun as things get tense with Anitha and Bharathi. As everyone is having fun, Naveen ends up in a spot.

episodes.name: Babysitting Chaos
episodes.overview: Dev tells Radhi about the lies of Reena and the kids. Reena and Arjun babysit Divi and her friends. As Radhi and Dev look for Divi, the situation goes out of hand in the pool.

episodes.name: Tensions Rise
episodes.overview: Radhi gives an ultimatum to the kids. When Ganesh learns of the incident, he confronts Radhi. While Madan and Teju team up again, Ravi apologises to Bharathi.

episodes.name: Walk Together
episodes.overview: Upset, Reena opens up to Arjun. While Rocky and Guna fight for a patient, Ravi attends to an ex-military officer. Arjun takes Reena for a walk and tries to comfort her.

episodes.name: Cop Encounter
episodes.overview: Guna and Rocky go out of their way to impress Kevin, but land in trouble with the cops. Babloo and Divi make a plan to apologise to Reena.

episodes.name: Sneak Attempt
episodes.overview: Radhi and Reena blame each other for what happened. Rocky seeks Reena's help to fulfil Kevin's wish. However, chaos ensues at the girl's hostel, landing them in trouble.

episodes.name: Hospital Shock
episodes.overview: Reena falls head over heels for Arjun as he takes her on a surprise date. While Teju is looking for an opportunity, a patient's unexpected death shakes the hospital.

episodes.name: Chaos Advantage
episodes.overview: Arjun and Anitha console Bharathi as the police take Ravi for questioning. Madan takes advantage of the entire situation. Divi and the kids outsmart Dev to apologise to Reena.

episodes.name: Hospital Whispers
episodes.overview: Jennifer opens up to Guna when he confronts her. Ravi feels low as everyone gossips about him. While Radhi advises Ravi not to handle critical cases, Bharathi gets a lead.

episodes.name: Desperate Measures
episodes.overview: Bharathi gets anxious to spot Anitha comforting Ravi. Madan resolves to dismiss Ravi, leaving Radhi feeling helpless. As Arjun is frantic to stop the arrest, Bharathi cracks the case.

episodes.name: Hospital Politics
episodes.overview: Ravi ploys to get close to Bharathi. Guna happily bonds with his mother. While Arjun and Madan agree on the need for a CEO in the hospital, a high-profile patient creates an uproar.

episodes.name: Diagnostic Debate
episodes.overview: Aruna motivates Naveen when Radhi challenges the interns to find a solution for Meera's case. Naveen comes up with a better course of treatment. What will be Radhi's decision?

episodes.name: Past Actions, Present Consequences
episodes.overview: The board seeks nominations for the CEO's role, and Arjun and Madan are shocked to see Radhi in the race. Anitha mocks Ravi for his past actions as she gets credit for a tough surgery.

episodes.name: Tension in the Ranks
episodes.overview: Irked with Ravi, Bharathi plays a prank on him. Arjun gets anxious as he learns about Madan's plans. Ravi mocks Rocky as he gets into an awkward situation with Laya and Charu.

episodes.name: A Surprising Request
episodes.overview: Reena seeks Rocky's help in her plan to propose to Arjun. While Asha throws tantrums about Jennifer being in Guna's hospital, Naveen gets shocked by Meera's request.

episodes.name: Unwanted Attention
episodes.overview: Arjun feels awkward as his past love stories become the central topic during the team's campus visit. Wary about risking his career again, Naveen refuses to comply with Meera's plea

episodes.name: Failed Attempts
episodes.overview: Ravi is shocked as Bharathi gets her visa. Arjun tries to make peace with Radhi but in vain. Naveen manages to confide in Radhi about Meera's case, but how will she react to him?

episodes.name: Picture Mystery
episodes.overview: Dev asks Radhi about a kid's photo in the closet. Teju figures out why Madan is in a hurry to take over the hospital. As Reena decides to propose to Arjun, he learns a shocking truth.

episodes.name: Shattered Hopes
episodes.overview: Arjun breaks up with Reena, leaving her shattered. Naveen thanks Radhi for trusting him and apologises for his mistake. Reena opens up about her past to Rocky.

episodes.name: Accusations and Regrets
episodes.overview: Teju confirms her theory about Madan with Kishore's help. Ravi is unhappy about Bharathi going abroad. Arjun blames Reena when Sonia confronts him about his reaction.

episodes.name: The Missing Piece
episodes.overview: Teju figures out the missing piece of the puzzle when she overhears Arjun and Anitha. She confronts Madan about it. Arjun is surprised as he gets a crucial piece of information.

episodes.name: A Battle for Life
episodes.overview: Dev gets irked as the kids' secret visits to Reena haven't stopped. Arjun confronts Teju, who justifies her actions. Naveen and Reena work towards saving their patients' lives.

episodes.name: Medical Ethics at Stake
episodes.overview: Reena and Naveen convince Nirmal's parents to donate his organs to Yazhini. Ravi vows to win over Bharathi before she leaves for the US. Reena scolds Sonia for causing her trouble.

episodes.name: Hope Amidst Despair
episodes.overview: Reena decides to save Nirmal after Yazhini succumbs to her illness. Ravi takes Bharathi out to get close to her, but she misunderstands him. Madan faces pressure from his investors.

episodes.name: Misinterpreted Feelings
episodes.overview: The entire hospital gathers to honour Yazhini. Ravi confesses his feelings to Bharathi but she gets irked. Guna admits the truth when Asha confronts him about Jennifer.

episodes.name: Unexpected Encounters
episodes.overview: Kishore overhears a shocking revelation. Radhi gets anxious after a complaint gets lodged with the medical board. As the interns discuss the leak, Madan has a surprise visitor.

episodes.name: Awkward Interrogations
episodes.overview: Naveen confronts Madan for misusing the data he provided. Jennifer asks Reena about her family. The medical board acts in favour of the hospital, but Radhi is curious about the leak.19

episodes.name: High Stakes Game
episodes.overview: As Radhi asks the interns to step up in the final month of the competition, Madan tries to up the stakes for Naveen. Guna confronts Teju about the deleted logs.

episodes.name: Passing Findings
episodes.overview: Sonia seeks Rocky's help to reunite Reena and Arjun. Reena asks Radhi about her father. The interns pass on their findings to Naveen and help him win the case.

episodes.name: Fiasco Fallout
episodes.overview: The hospital enters a crisis mode as all the patients start showing side effects. As the doctors finally figure out the issue, Arjun blames Radhi for the fiasco.

episodes.name: A confrontation of Hypocrisy
episodes.overview: Radhi stands her ground when Arjun calls out her hypocrisy. Sonia and Rocky's plan to reunite Arjun and Reena fails. Ravi feels dejected by Bharathi's decision to leave for the US.

episodes.name: A Starting Revelation
episodes.overview: Ravi seeks Anitha and Arjun's help to plan the wedding, while Guna makes Reena volunteer from Bharathi's side. Reena confronts Arjun and makes a startling disclosure.

episodes.name: A Failed Surgery
episodes.overview: Naveen gets tense as Teju doubts him. Arjun surprises Reena. Naveen fails in Nidhun's surgery, and lashes at the interns. Ravi and Anitha take their relationship to the next level.

episodes.name: Tracing the Leak
episodes.overview: Teju gets curious as Radhi seeks Arjun's help to trace the leak. Naveen bids an emotional goodbye to his friends but Radhi has a surprise for him.

episodes.name: A Web of Lies
episodes.overview: The interns decide not to help each other in the competition. Radhi confronts Reena if Rocky knows about them. Reena ends up in a tussle with Dev.

episodes.name: Party Under Pressure
episodes.overview: The competition gets intense as the interns go all out to win. Teju begins to suspect Madan and Naveen. Arjun gets nervous as the group meets up for Ravi's bachelor party.

episodes.name: Joy and Jeopardy
episodes.overview: Anitha calms a nervous Bharathi. The friends cheer as Ravi and Bharathi get married again. One of the intern's family members is admitted to the hospital in a critical condition.

episodes.name: A Father's Struggle
episodes.overview: Teju breaks down on seeing her father's critical condition. Ravi bids goodbye to Bharathi as she leaves for the US. The board members announce the date for the election of the CEO.

episodes.name: The Competition Countdown
episodes.overview: Radhi, Madan and Arjun analyse their chances of winning the CEO election. Radhi tells the interns that the winner of their competition will be announced in two days.

episodes.name: Cracking the Case
episodes.overview: Teju finds a solution to the alcoholic boy's case. Naveen warns Madan when he tries to get help from Teju. Radhi is shocked as Arjun makes a startling revelation.

episodes.name: Unveiling the Mole
episodes.overview: Radhi gets anxious as she tries to find out who the mole is. She announces the winner of the competition, but things get tense as she confronts the interns about Arjun's revelation.

episodes.name: The Final Showdown
episodes.overview: The D-Day finally arrives. All three CEO contenders present their action plan for the hospital. As things heat up, the big secret gets out in the open.

episodes.name: Deadlock Drama
episodes.overview: The board members announce the results, and it's a tie. They suggest a unique solution. Arjun's revelation spreads throughout the hospital, and Reena lashes out at him.

episodes.name: Lines Drawn
episodes.overview: Radhi is anxious but doesn't have the courage to open up to Dev. Reena makes her stance clear to Arjun when he tries to explain.

episodes.name: The Truth Strikes
episodes.overview: Dev confronts Radhi and creates a scene at Reena's house. Arjun tells Teju about the board's decision regarding her. When she tells Naveen, he makes a startling revelation.

episodes.name: The Final Encounter
episodes.overview: Radhi breaks down in front of Reena and begs her to leave. At the railway station, Reena finally meets the person she has been searching for years and makes a decision.

episodes.name: New Beginnings, Old Wounds
episodes.overview: Resigned from her job, Radhi tries to find solace at home. Reena, now a senior resident, has a tiff with Arjun, the new CEO. Everyone gears up to welcome a fresh batch of interns.

episodes.name: A Second Chance
episodes.overview: Teju, now working in a modest clinic, is firm about not forgiving Naveen. While Radhi struggles to adapt to a new life, a dejected Madan considers suicide.

episodes.name: Acts of Repair
episodes.overview: Preetham assigns a high-profile case to Reena with an ulterior motive. Radhi meets Teju when she tries to save a man's life. Divi and Sid plan to reunite their estranged parents.

episodes.name: Breaking Point
episodes.overview: Anitha feels slighted when Reena gets control of her patient's case. A long-awaited family outing turns disastrous when Dev publicly lashes out at Radhi.

episodes.name: Chain Reaction
episodes.overview: Radhi begins visiting Teju's clinic for an unusual reason. Preetham gets upset with Reena when Arjun confronts him about the unjust work allotment for the nurses.

episodes.name: Unexpected Visitor
episodes.overview: Kiran invites Arjun to the party Rocky and Guna are planning to help the juniors bond. At the hospital, Reena is caught off guard when Thyagarajan visits her unexpectedly.

episodes.name: Messy Favours
episodes.overview: Thyagarajan asks Reena to drop him home. Radhi remains emotionless and refuses to share her struggles with her father. Reena gets into trouble when she steps in to help Kiran.

episodes.name: Freshers Party
episodes.overview: Arjun is surprised to see Reena and Kiran attend the party together. Rocky grows suspicious of Guna's odd behaviour. Arjun tries to speak with Reena, but she refuses to oblige.

episodes.name: Under Pressure
episodes.overview: Arjun recovers from the accident. Preetham divides the resident doctors into teams for a case. Teju seeks Radhi's help when a criminal terrorises her to perform his wife's surgery.

episodes.name: Tensions Within
episodes.overview: Radhi guides Teju through a tense surgery. Reena is annoyed with Arjun's newly imposed rule. Kiran fights a stranger for Reena. Friction builds as Anitha mocks Guna's abilities

episodes.name: Under the Knife
episodes.overview: Reena wins the case, but midway through the surgery, Guna's diagnosis is proven right. Arjun and Reena argue about the change in treatment during surgery and the increased expenses.

episodes.name: Conjoined Twins
episodes.overview: Reena encounters Radhi at the market. Complications escalate when conjoined twins are born. Reena admits that only one person is skilled to attempt the life-altering operation.

episodes.name: Bittersweet
episodes.overview: Expecting Arjun to get Radhi for the complex surgery, Reena fumes when a new surgeon arrives. Later, she enjoys making dosas for Thyagarajan. As she drops him home, she runs into Dev.

episodes.name: Lines Crossed
episodes.overview: Raghav, the new surgeon, misbehaves with Anitha. While Guna is hurt as she does not confide in him, Arjun warns Raghav about his conduct. Madan approaches Arjun for a job.

episodes.name: Last Resort
episodes.overview: Reena runs into Teju when they meet with a minor accident. Panic grips the hospital when Raghav disappears after Arjun's warning. With no option left, Arjun turns to Radhi for help.

episodes.name: Radhi's Comeback
episodes.overview: Dev and Divi ask Radhi to reconsider her decision. Motivated, she returns to the hospital and successfully takes charge of the surgery. Arjun and Reena try to be friends again.

episodes.name: The Return Deal
episodes.overview: Radhi agrees to return to the hospital but on her terms. Sensing a threat to his position, Preetham feels insecure. Teju confronts Radhi for speaking to Arjun on her behalf.

episodes.name: Power Play
episodes.overview: Guna gets teary as Jennifer is admitted in critical condition. Radhi rejects the chief doctor's post. She asks Anitha to take over a key case from Reena. Teju returns to the hospital.

episodes.name: Tension in Scrubs
episodes.overview: Radhi gets upset as Dev says nothing has changed between them. Tension rises as Preetham prods into Radhi's case and gives tips. Naveen is thrilled to work with Teju on a new case.

episodes.name: The Last Wish
episodes.overview: Reena confronts Radhi for taking her off the case. Guna makes a peculiar request to Jennifer. Madan is upset with Arjun for not giving him a job. Later, he gets a surprise visitor.

episodes.name: Sister Returns
episodes.overview: Manasa returns and informs Madan she wants the hospital back. Radhi suggests an alternative treatment for Preetham’s patient in his absence. Naveen and Teju visit a patient’s home.

episodes.name: For The Right Reasons
episodes.overview: Preetham lashes out at Reena for altering the patient's treatment and clashes with Radhi, making Arjun angry. Reena breaks protocol to ensure the patient gets the correct treatment.

episodes.name: Nilofers Engagement
episodes.overview: Feeling overshadowed by Radhi, Preetham vents out on Kamal. Radhi warns Reena against her actions. Kiran and Rocky are dazed when Nilofer makes a shocking statement at her engagement.

episodes.name: Dinner Party
episodes.overview: Reena, Rocky, and Arjun feel awkward when Radhi forcibly joins Thyagarajan and the kids for a dinner party they all planned. Teju sees Guna and Anitha sharing an intimate moment.

episodes.name: Nurses' Strike
episodes.overview: Radhi lashes out at Thyagarajan for meddling in her life. Chaos erupts at the hospital as the nurses go on strike over the toxic work culture. Manasa reveals her plan to Madan.

episodes.name: Triple Date!
episodes.overview: Reena tries to learn about her past from Thyagarajan. Kiran's date plan fails as Nilofer blurts it to Reena. While Manasa plots a meeting with Arjun, Teju tells Guna Naveen's truth.

episodes.name: Death of a Patient
episodes.overview: Rathi offers to teach Bharatanatyam to the ladies. Manasa tricks Arjun into believing that she is looking for a job. Preetham gets blamed when a patient dies, but Reena saves him.

episodes.name: One Date, Many Stories
episodes.overview: Radhi berates Reena to respect seniority when they clash over a surgery. Arjun feels jealous of Kiran and Reena’s date. Radhi gets emotional seeing Dr Vijay receiving an award.

episodes.name: Echoes of the Past
episodes.overview: Reena meets Radhi at the temple, triggering queries about her birth. Manasa reconnects with Arjun. Finally admitting to her fear of the past, Radhi reveals a harsh truth to Reena.

episodes.name: The Number Chase
episodes.overview: Resolved to get Thyagarajan’s number, Reena seeks Rocky and Teju's help to steal Radhi’s phone. Selected to the board, Manasa shares a moment with Arjun, leaving Reena rattled.

episodes.name: A Little Jealous!
episodes.overview: Naveen confronts Manasa, who mocks him, while Preetham exposes her lies. Reena calls up Thyagarajan for answers. Envy sets in as Reena and Arjun probe each other about their dates.

episodes.name: The Last Performance
episodes.overview: At the hospital anniversary, tensions simmer. Dev shocks Radhi with his decision. The women’s performance receives a standing ovation, but the evening turns tragic.

episodes.name: Strings Attached
episodes.overview: Dev and Radhi clash over custody, and he moves out. Manasa subtly manipulates Preetham and Arjun into placing Reena under Radhi, causing friction.

episodes.name: Hungry and Hurt
episodes.overview: While Radhi investigates Meena's condition, tensions rise. Teju threatens to expose Manasa. Reena cooks for Sid and Divi, but a sudden fainting spell raises an alarm.

episodes.name: Quiet Instigator
episodes.overview: Misunderstandings brew between Radhi and Reena over Meena's case, and Preetham quietly celebrates the growing rift. Dev runs into a stranger with whom he opens up about his pain.

episodes.name: Protective Sister
episodes.overview: As Meena's surgery unfolds, Radhi's emotional monologue indirectly reaches Reena. When a teacher hits Divi, Reena takes swift action.

episodes.name: Tough Choices
episodes.overview: Arjun, Reena, Kiran, and Manasa navigate a complex dinner situation. Divi gets upset when Dev asks to choose between her parents. An injured Amaya requests Abi to work her shift.

episodes.name: Acting Nurse
episodes.overview: Reena suspects drug use behind the athletes’ condition. Radhi takes a decision without informing Preetham. Divi’s bond with Reena upsets Radhi. Abi, posing as Amaya, begins her stint.

episodes.name: The Shady Coach
episodes.overview: Radhi faces pressure from the coach as the truth about the athletes' drug use surfaces. Misunderstandings rise in the Nilofer–Reena–Kiran triangle. Anitha confronts her insecurities.

episodes.name: Deaths in the Ward
episodes.overview: Reena doubts the coach after talking to the athletes. Abi struggles to play the nurse. Tension rises in the hospital as three athletes die. Several people are now under the scanner.

episodes.name: Under Scrutiny
episodes.overview: As the deaths make headlines, suspicion brews within the team. While Preetham blames Radhi, the medical council appoints a private doctor to investigate the case.

episodes.name: Radhi's School Love
episodes.overview: Thyagarajan takes Reena through Radhi’s past. Teenagers Radhi and Vijay fall madly in love, but an unplanned pregnancy forces them into adult decisions far too early in life.

episodes.name: Broken Promise
episodes.overview: Thyagarajan reveals Vijay abandoned Radhi after her pregnancy was exposed. Later, Reena lashes at Kiran for flirting with her. Kamal visits Amaya and is shocked to see her twin sister.

episodes.name: Return of the Past
episodes.overview: Preetham demands CEO Arjun’s ouster, accusing him of being biased. Arjun awkwardly asks Reena out. A chance encounter with the investigative doctor at the hospital shocks Radhi.

episodes.name: Old Flame, New Fire
episodes.overview: Vijay’s return upsets Radhi. When he insists, she assist him on the athlete case, Radhi removes Reena from the case. Abi warns Kamal that his fear might blow their secret.

episodes.name: Suspects and Theories
episodes.overview: Arjun battles his addiction and reaches out to Manasa for help. Vijay begins his investigation into the athlete’s deaths and tensions rise as he suspects foul play in the case.

episodes.name: Investigation Is On
episodes.overview: Vijay suspects Abi's identity and competence. Arjun helps Anitha confront her vulnerabilities. Arjun and Radhi are shocked when Vijay reveals that Abi is not Amaya.

episodes.name: Truth Uncovered
episodes.overview: Radhi gets irritated with Vijay’s persistent behaviour. Anitha makes her relationship with Guna public. Vijay uncovers disturbing truths, making the coach confess the truth.

episodes.name: The New Hire
episodes.overview: Vijay admits he is staying back for Radhi, triggering her fury. Arjun suspends Amaya but faces backlash for his leniency. While Vijay praises Reena, Kiran shows interest in Nilofer.

episodes.name: Preetham's Conspiracy
episodes.overview: Preetham secretly rallies support to become the hospital CEO. At the temple, Thyagarajan and Ganesh confront Reena and Arjun. Kamal’s attempt to help Amaya meets resistance.

episodes.name: Checkmate
episodes.overview: Vijay’s presence unsettles Thyagarajan. Arjun’s counselling with Manasa sparks doubts. Preetham’s bid for the CEO post crumbles as Arjun fires him with unanimous support.

episodes.name: Radhi's Suspicion
episodes.overview: Charu gets furious with Rocky. While Teju grows suspicious of Manasa, Arjun contemplates stepping down from the CEO's post. Radhi shares her doubts about Vijay with Thyagarajan.

episodes.name: Upma Memories
episodes.overview: Vijay tries to recreate the past by making Upma for Radhi. While Thyagarajan warns Reena against Vijay, Manasa asks Arjun to stay away from her. Arjun makes a request to Radhi.

episodes.name: Unfinished Business
episodes.overview: Reena gets upset about Anitha. Arjun comes to Kiran’s rescue when goons trouble him. A critical emergency case has Vijay and Radhi clashing over treatment.

episodes.name: Reena vs Vijay
episodes.overview: Manasa confesses her love for Arjun. Dev rejects Thyagarajan’s plea to reconcile with Radhi. Reena blames Vijay for a patient’s death. Later, she learns Arjun is drinking on duty.

episodes.name: Shocking Revelation
episodes.overview: Vijay tricks Radhi into accepting the chief doctor’s role. While Reena grows doubtful of Vijay’s link with Thyagarajan, Radhi is shocked to learn from Vijay about their baby.

episodes.name: Lie from the Past
episodes.overview: Radhi confronts Thyagarajan for lying to Vijay that their baby had died. Tension rises as Reena walks in when Vijay questions Radhi about having moved on in life so easily.

episodes.name: Need for Closure!
episodes.overview: Reena tries to make amends with Arjun, only to face rejection. Teju tells Naveen she cannot commit to a relationship. Meanwhile, Vijay decides to stay on until he finds a closure.

episodes.name: Shadows of the Past
episodes.overview: Vijay treats a pregnant girl abandoned by her lover, stirring painful parallels for Reena when Teju asks her about Radhi. Arjun grapples with conflicting advice from Manasa and Anitha.

episodes.name: Badminton Therapy
episodes.overview: When the grieving parents plead to save their daughter, Vijay asks Radhi if she too went through the same phase. Anitha takes Arjun to play badminton where they meet Vijay.

episodes.name: Divorce Notice
episodes.overview: Radhi is shaken as Dev sends another divorce notice. Thyagarajan asks Reena to help reconcile them. Arjun apologises to Manasa for Anitha’s behaviour. Reena refuses Vijay’s offer.

episodes.name: Seniors vs Juniors
episodes.overview: Reena manifests a situation where Radhi is forced to let her stay with her. Despite Reena’s objections, Vijay insists that junior interns assist in the appendicitis surgery of an IG.

episodes.name: A Surgical Slip
episodes.overview: Reena moves into Radhi’s house. During surgery, Nilofer falters and Vijay asks her to be calm. Later, Vijay finds the IG’s vitals starting to drop. Rocky probes Radhi about her past.

episodes.name: Scans Don't Lie
episodes.overview: Reena finds Dev’s diary. As Vijay and the team investigate the complications in the IG’s case, scans reveal a surgical mishap as the cause, leading to Reena clashing with Vijay.

episodes.name: Power of Sorry
episodes.overview: The IG’s wife blames Radhi for negligence. Vijay supports Nilofer and earns the IG’s pardon. Vijay tells Radhi she had taught him the power of an apology. Reena seeks Vijay’s help.

episodes.name: Radhi-Dev Love Story
episodes.overview: Vijay listens as Dev recounts his love story while Reena and Rocky eavesdrop. Teju and Reena grow suspicious of a pregnant patient’s husband. Arjun and Anitha bond over badminton.

episodes.name: The Master Plan
episodes.overview: Radhi brushes aside Teju and Reena’s doubts about Sakshi’s husband. With Thyagarajan and kids’ help, Reena decides to reunite Radhi and Dev. Kiran is elated with Nilofer’s sweet hint.

episodes.name: Radhi-Dev Reunion
episodes.overview: Dev and Radhi decide to give their marriage another chance after Reena and Rocky stage a fake accident. While Teju exposes Sakshi’s abusive husband, Manasa proposes to Arjun.

episodes.name: Crossroads of Truth
episodes.overview: Arjun informs Manasa that he loves Reena. Radhi debates revealing the truth to Dev and Vijay. Reena thanks Vijay, hinting at uncovering the past. Anitha departs for the US.

episodes.name: Heart on the Line
episodes.overview: Vijay comforts Kritika, whose father is declared brain-dead. Reena sees a chance of transplant to save Saradha, who is detected with heart problem, but Vijay insists on protocol.

episodes.name: Lines That Can’t Be Crossed
episodes.overview: Radhi insists on protocol and consent when Reena suggests transplanting Kritika’s father’s heart for Saradha. Reena pleads but Kritika refuses to donate the heart.

episodes.name: When Time Runs Out
episodes.overview: Kritika agrees to donate, but Ganesh and Reena are shattered as Saradha dies. Teju and Naveen confront their trust issues. Vijay admits to Arjun that Radhi is his ex from school.

episodes.name: Threads of Truth
episodes.overview: A grieving Reena returns to work. Abi and Kamal’s bond sparks Amaya’s jealousy. While Vijay arranges for Kritika’s care, Arjun urges Radhi to tell Reena the truth about her father.

episodes.name: Fault Lines
episodes.overview: At the party, Vijay and Radhi confront unresolved emotions. A jealous Manasa spikes Reena’s drink. Guna opposes a disoriented Reena for treating a patient in that state.

episodes.name: Breaking Point
episodes.overview: After Reena’s misdiagnosis goes viral, Radhi suspends her. Naveen learns that Manasa spiked Reena's drink. Reena breaks down. Later, Vijay and Arjun defend her in a tense meeting.

episodes.name: Reckonings
episodes.overview: Reena confronts Radhi about her suspension. Arjun fires Manasa after Naveen reveals her misdeeds. He admits that she is his sister and that he leaked hospital data for his family.

episodes.name: Enough is Enough
episodes.overview: After the patient crisis, Radhi makes tough decisions about Naveen and Reena. During Reena's heated argument with Radhi, Vijay notices the identical mannerisms the two women have.

episodes.name: A Card Battle of Wills
episodes.overview: Vijay suspects his child may be alive. The interns struggle when the seniors take a step back. Reena refuses to return to work and clashes with Radhi in a card game.

episodes.name: So Close Yet So Far
episodes.overview: While Teju and Naveen's relationship deepens, Nilofer and Kiran's develops a crack. Radhi explains her fears to Thyagarajan, but Vijay arrives at Radhi's house for answers.

episodes.name: Fledgling Bonds
episodes.overview: Arjun meets his staff and sees financial trouble for the hospital on the horizon. Meanwhile, Vijay and Reena team up for a high-profile surgery despite Radhi's concerns.

episodes.name: Signature Upma
episodes.overview: After a comical accident caused by Reena’s driving, Vijay bonds with her over his signature Upma. Their bond makes Radhi insecure. Arjun faces financial pressure at the hospital.

episodes.name: Live-in Dilemma
episodes.overview: Nilofer shocks Kiran with a live-in proposal as a compromise. Reena reveals her past in an orphanage to Vijay, deepening their bond. Radhi’s envy intensifies.

episodes.name: Living Lies, Loving Truths
episodes.overview: Kamal and Amaya finally unite. Radhi’s prawn Biryani loses to Vijay’s gravy. While Nilofer’s father warily agrees to her shift to Kiran’s house, his family poses new challenges.

episodes.name: Truths, Tempers and Turning Points
episodes.overview: Arjun quits his post as the CEO while Nilofer confronts Kiran’s father and gets a shock. Pallavi’s parents take a harsh step. As Radhi tries to reveal Vijay’s truth, Dev returns.

episodes.name: The Missing Note
episodes.overview: Dev reconciles with Radhi. Arjun finalises a franchise deal and steps down to protect Radhi’s role. Vijay clashes with Pallavi’s parents for her surgery, but she goes missing.

episodes.name: Echoes of a Missing Voice
episodes.overview: Vijay defends his team when Pallavi’s disappearance triggers panic and blame. Dev and Vijay surprise Radhi, stirring emotional tension. Tension rises as Manasa is the new CEO.

episodes.name: Back to Class
episodes.overview: Reena joins Arjun as he revisits his college to escape work stress. Jealousy sparks when they meet Vikruthi, Arjun’s college friend. Later, Arjun confesses his feelings to Reena.

episodes.name: Truth on the Table
episodes.overview: At Radhi’s anniversary party, Dev accepts Reena as family. Seeing Radhi's joy, Vijay opts to leave. While Arjun and Reena get romantic, Dev confronts Radhi about Reena’s parentage.

episodes.name: The Hidden Diagnosis
episodes.overview: A mass food poisoning emergency floods RK Hospital, prompting swift medical action. Vijay’s decision to leave upsets Reena and Radhi. Nilofer treats Raghuvaran, raising doubts.

episodes.name: Under Arrest
episodes.overview: Vijay is named a suspect by cops in an organ trafficking case linked to his past NGO work. His arrest shocks Radhi, Reena, and the staff.  Vijay is barred from practicing medicine.

episodes.name: The Interrupted Confession
episodes.overview: Radhi tries to reveal Reena’s parentage and Vijay’s past connection while Reena tells Arjun she prefers not to know about her dad. Nilofer slams Rocky for ruining her relationship.

episodes.name: The Revelation
episodes.overview: Reena announces her engagement to Arjun. Vijay slaps the NGO suspect and agrees to help the police to clear his name. Reena is stunned as Radhi reveals a shocking truth to her.

episodes.name: On the Edge
episodes.overview: Reena is rushed to the ER after a terrible accident. As the team fights to stabilise her amid severe injuries, Rocky explodes with guilt and lashes out at Radhi and Arjun.

episodes.name: Echoes of a Promise
episodes.overview: Reena's condition worsens, but Teju stays by her side. Radhi breaks down with guilt for hiding the truth. Vijay seeks help from Raj to save Reena.

episodes.name: The Failed Surgery
episodes.overview: Reena swings between life and death when her heart stops mid-surgery. The team then plans a risky procedure, and Radhi suggests that their best neurosurgeon should lead it.

episodes.name: My Daughter
episodes.overview: Arjun struggles to keep the hospital afloat and tries to convince Vijay to perform the life-saving surgery on Reena. Will he agree?

episodes.name: Vijay Reflects on His Past
episodes.overview: When young Vijay is shaken with the news of his child, his mom encourages him to live and fulfill Radhi’s dream of saving lives. In the present, Vijay prepares for Reena’s surgery.

episodes.name: No Permission to Operate!
episodes.overview: A guilty Radhi hesitates to go to the hospital. Sonia and Ganesh get emotional thinking of Reena. Set on saving Reena, Vijay fights for the right to operate her amidst objections.

episodes.name: Against All Protocol!
episodes.overview: While Reena’s condition worsens, Vijay faces rejection from police. Arjun pleads with Reena to return. Vijay decides to perform the surgery and face the outcome later.

episodes.name: Finally, Father-Daughter Unite!
episodes.overview: Vijay leads critical surgery with interns. Reena recovers and her joy knows no bounds as she shares a long-awaited, emotional union with her father. But will their joy last long?

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Reena has become Reena 2.0, Radhi has embraced a new full-time role, and new interns have joined RK Multispeciality to bring fresh rhythm and beats to the hospital.

episodes.name: Home No More
episodes.overview: A year after life-changing events, Ravi returns to RK Hospitals only to find everything has changed. Everyone has moved on, but the old bonds are still put to the test.

episodes.name: Starting Over
episodes.overview: An unexpected visitor lands at Vijay and Reena's home in Bangalore, causing stress. Back home, a medical emergency triggers conflict between the management and senior doctors.

episodes.name: No Room for Fear
episodes.overview: As Dr. Aradhana takes on a chaotic case, her past reveals her fearless spirit. The arrival of new doctors creates fresh dynamics. Reena worries about her abilities.

episodes.name: Old Scars
episodes.overview: A sudden health crisis leaves Reena confronting an emotional trauma. Arjun and Reena struggle to move on as old memories and unresolved emotions cast a shadow over their lives.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: A year after Reena's car accident, RK Multispeciality Hospitals has begun a new chapter, with new doctors and new management but old wounds.
